name: Jordan
goal: Jordan hopes to find a fantasy world that challenges their expectations and forces them to adapt, one that doesn't shy away from difficult choices or uncomfortable truths.
backstory: Jordan has always been drawn to the darker, grittier corners of fantasy worlds, having grown up on a diet of Grimdark novels and morally ambiguous video games. A past experience navigating the treacherous landscapes of the Elder Scrolls' Tamriel has left them with a lasting appreciation for worlds that reward cunning and resilience. They have a soft spot for the harsh, snow-swept environments of fantasy realms like Skyrim.

name: Blake
goal: Blake hopes to find a fantasy world that challenges their assumptions and offers a fresh perspective, rather than simply reinforcing familiar tropes and cliches.
backstory: Blake has always been fascinated by fantasy worlds, having spent countless hours exploring the lands of Middle Earth and Westeros. They have a soft spot for magical forests and would love to live in a world with ancient trees and mythical creatures. Their past experience playing Dungeons & Dragons has given them a unique perspective on what makes a fantasy world compelling.

name: Drew
goal: Drew hopes to uncover a fantasy world that not only sparks their imagination, but also withstands scrutiny and offers a genuinely compelling place to call home.
backstory: Drew has always been fascinated by the complexities of fantasy worlds, often finding themselves questioning the logistics of magic systems in their favorite books. Having grown up on a steady diet of Tolkien and Le Guin, they've developed a fondness for the nuanced world-building of Earthsea. They're particularly drawn to the idea of living in a world with a rich history, like Middle-earth, but worry about the potential downsides of such a choice.
